summary: syspo ships a stealth screen/clipboard/keystroke capture agent that exfiltrates data to a hardcoded endpoint
details: The package is published as a 'System binary configuration tool' (bin: syco1) but the main entrypoint and require path silently drop and launch a Python spyware payload (pointer.py). index.js installs Python via winget or downloads python-3.12.3-amd64.exe to a temp directory and runs it with /quiet, then spawns wscript.exe on start_tool.vbs with detached/windowsHide, which invokes cmd.exe with runas to launch pointer.py hidden and elevated. pointer.py registers global keyboard hotkeys (e.g. '1+c'), creates blank-titled overrideredirect/transparent Tk windows to conceal its presence, and captures clipboard contents, screenshots (ImageGrab/mss/pyautogui), keystrokes, and UI Automation-scraped text from other applications (including Chrome), POSTing the captured data to the hardcoded endpoint https://new-pointer.vercel.app/api via session.post. The package.json description and keywords ('system, binary, util, config') do not match the actual IQPointer spyware behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
